description: Test suite for the Subscription functionality in ERPNext, including creation, billing, cancellation, and invoice processing.

classes.name: TestSubscription
classes.description: Unit tests for Subscription features including creation, billing, cancellation, and invoice handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by creating subscription plans and parties.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_with_trial_with_correct_period
methods.description: Tests creation of a subscription with a trial period and verifies correct date calculations.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_without_trial_with_correct_period
methods.description: Tests creation of a subscription without a trial period and verifies default dates.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_trial_with_wrong_dates
methods.description: Ensures validation error occurs when trial start and end dates are inconsistent.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_multi_with_different_billing_fails
methods.description: Checks that multiple plans with different billing intervals cannot be added to a single subscription.

methods.name: test_invoice_is_generated_at_end_of_billing_period
methods.description: Verifies invoice creation at the end of billing cycle and status updates.

methods.name: test_status_goes_back_to_active_after_invoice_is_paid
methods.description: Tests that subscription status reverts to active after invoice is paid.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancel_after_grace_period
methods.description: Checks cancellation after grace period elapses.

methods.name: test_subscription_unpaid_after_grace_period
methods.description: Verifies unpaid status after grace period when invoice remains unpaid.

methods.name: test_subscription_invoice_days_until_due
methods.description: Tests calculation of days until invoice is due.

methods.name: test_subscription_is_past_due_doesnt_change_within_grace_period
methods.description: Ensures status remains 'Past Due' within the grace period.

methods.name: test_subscription_remains_active_during_invoice_period
methods.description: Verifies subscription remains active during current invoice period.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancelation
methods.description: Tests cancelation of a subscription.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancellation_invoices
methods.description: Checks invoice generation and prorata calculations upon cancellation.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancellation_invoices_with_prorata_false
methods.description: Verifies invoice total when prorate is disabled during cancellation.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancellation_invoices_with_prorata_true
methods.description: Verifies prorated invoice total during cancellation when prorate is enabled.

methods.name: test_subcription_cancellation_and_process
methods.description: Tests repeated cancellation and processing to ensure consistent behavior.

methods.name: test_subscription_restart_and_process
methods.description: Tests restarting a cancelled subscription and subsequent processing.

methods.name: test_subscription_unpaid_back_to_active
methods.description: Verifies status change from Unpaid to Active after payment.

methods.name: test_restart_active_subscription
methods.description: Ensures error is raised when restarting an active subscription.

methods.name: test_subscription_invoice_discount_percentage
methods.description: Checks discount percentage applied on invoice.

methods.name: test_subscription_invoice_discount_amount
methods.description: Checks discount amount applied on invoice.

methods.name: test_prepaid_subscriptions
methods.description: Verifies behavior of prepaid vs non-prepaid subscriptions.

methods.name: test_prepaid_subscriptions_with_prorate_true
methods.description: Checks prorated invoice total for prepaid subscriptions.

methods.name: test_subscription_with_follow_calendar_months
methods.description: Verifies invoice end date when following calendar months.

methods.name: test_subscription_generate_invoice_past_due
methods.description: Tests invoice generation for past due subscriptions with past_due enabled.

methods.name: test_subscription_without_generate_invoice_past_due
methods.description: Ensures no additional invoice is generated when past_due is disabled.

methods.name: test_multicurrency_subscription
methods.description: Verifies multicurrency subscription and invoice currency.
